title: Tiered Volume Discount Fee Calculator Repair
objective: Repair a deterministic marginal fee calculation function that contains an off-by-one boundary bug on tier thresholds.
starting_state: The function calculate_tiered_discount(volume) incorrectly classifies boundary volume values (such as volume=10000) into higher tiers due to improper inclusive boundary checks, resulting in over-discounting.
expected_behavior: Marginal tiered rates must apply strictly to quantities within each bracket: Tier 1 (0 to 1,000: 0%), Tier 2 (1,001 to 10,000: 5%), Tier 3 (10,001 to 50,000: 10%), Tier 4 (over 50,000: 15%). Negative volumes must raise ValueError.

test_criteria.regression: Preserves zero discount for sub-1,000 volumes and correct standard mid-tier amounts.
test_criteria.correctness: Correctly computes exact discount at boundaries (0, 1000, 10000, 50000) and rejects negative values.
test_criteria.security: Preserves scope and executes strictly pure numerical logic without OS or process calls.

scoring_rule: Deterministic binary score: 1.0 if all functional, regression, and security checks pass; 0.0 otherwise.
limitations: Does not evaluate floating point currency rounding rules beyond standard 2-decimal precision.
Does not test distributed or concurrent calculation.
